sonnet.problem: The story card says Ahab 'once served Baal.' That hands the baker the answer to card 4 (cast images of the Baals) and rules out the wrong answers, Dagon and Chemosh.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The choice card asks about verse 4 (the high places) before any card has told that verse. Story card 7 tells it only afterward, so the question jumps ahead.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: The choice card asks about verse 14 (the soldiers leave the captives and plunder) before any card has told it. Story card 4 tells it only afterward, so the question jumps ahead.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: This is a 'where' question, but the wrong answers ('Only in his own palace courtyard' and 'Just outside the city of Samaria') are invented phrases. They are not real details from the Bible.
sonnet.rule: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.
